result.quote: And in Jerusalem he made skillfully designed devices to shoot arrows and catapult large stones from the towers and corners.
result.reason: The window supports devices for shooting arrows and catapulting stones, but it does not say that skillful men invented them; it says Uzziah (“he”) made skillfully designed devices. Thus the question has an unsupported premise, even though “engines” is a reasonable paraphrase of the devices.
